So many of you asked for more app ideas after the last video with Emergent went viral. So here is another app idea that I think could have revenue potential.  Step 1: Use Claude to research Product Hunt and Reddit for app ideas that trending right now Step 2:Ask Claude to find a trending idea that you could build given your strengths and then come up with your own spin on it! Step 3: Go to Emergent and ask it to build the app for you! It will build out the entire app for you with AI, so you won’t have to do any coding! So many of you asked me for more AI app ideas after my last video went viral. So here's another one that could genuinely make you money. It's such a cheat code, so let me show you how it works. In less than 60 seconds, you're gonna go to Claude and then turn on research mode and web search by clicking right here. Now you're gonna go ask Claude to search Product Hunt and Reddit for apps that are trending right now. Claude will find app ideas where there is actual market demand that people would actually pay money for. Now use this prompt to get Claude to analyze all these trends to give you the best app idea that you could build right now, which has your own spin on it. Now you're gonna head to emergent and explain that exact app idea into this box right here. Emergent will now build out that entire app for you. I'm talking the design, the database and all the backend logic. You won't have to do any coding and you can even deploy it live to the internet by clicking right here. And now you have an app which has a real world market demands. So if you want to get started, comment emergent below and I'll send you the link.

This feels like one of those “wait… how is this free?” moments. OpenHuman is trending #1 on GitHub, and for good reason: it’s a private AI superintelligence that runs directly on your desktop. No API keys, no paid cloud plan, no hidden lock-in. Just a fully open-source AI agent you can actually control. What makes it wild is how personal it gets. Connect Gmail, Notion, GitHub, and Slack, and it auto-syncs into a local memory tree every 20 minutes. It can react to your screen, remember your workflow, and even join Google Meet like a real participant. Setup is surprisingly simple, especially compared to other AI agents. One command, desktop app installed, and you’re ready to go. Comment “open” and check the GitHub links. #AI #OpenSource #GitHub #AIAgent
Oh my god, this is actually crazy. After Openclaw and Hermes, we have got Openhuman. It is trending No. 1 on Github. It is a private AI super intelligence that runs on a desktop. It is fully open source and completely free. You don't need any API keys no chat, GPT Pro cloud subscription. You you can connect Gmail, Notion Git hub, Slack. It auto syncs every 20 minutes into the local memory tree. So the agent already knows everything about you. And the cutest part it has a little mascot with a face. You can literally talk to it. It reacts to your screen remembers you even joins Google Meet as a real participant. Compared to Open Claw and Hermes, the setup is very easy. You just hit this command and Open Human is installed as an app on your desktop. No cloud or VPS required. This is the comparison table they uploaded on the Git Hub repo. Open human versus other AI agents Cloud Co work, open Claw Hermes Agent. It has 100 + 18 integrations, fully private and completely open source. Comment open and find the links on Git Hub.
